course.title: Khaemenes Higher Learning Real & Complex Analysis
course.audience: Advanced undergraduates, graduate-preparatory learners, and independent researchers entering analysis, mathematical physics, PDE, probability, or complex variables.
course.prerequisite: A completed Introduction to Proofs course or equivalent proof fluency, single-variable calculus, and mathematical maturity. Linear algebra is strongly recommended.
course.credit_guidance: An advanced upper-level and graduate-preparatory sequence with selected beginning-graduate topics. It is not represented as a replacement for a university graduate qualifying sequence.
